outcome: Give grid operations director / chief asset officer a governed method to improve priority customer restoration time using outage incidents, crew skills and road access, with final decisions retained…
overview: Storm Restoration Crew Allocation addresses resource allocation is planned in silos, producing avoidable delays and occasionally infeasible instructions in power and utilities operations. The first proof of value uses outage incidents, crew skills and road access. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is priority customer restoration time, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: outage incidents, crew skills and road access; define priority customer restoration time and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Grid Operations Director / Chief Asset Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including replay disruption and edge cases with hard constraints enforced.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
